description: This file provides extensions to the FileManager class for asynchronous read and write operations using Combine publishers in a SwiftUI application. It defines methods to read data from and write data to files within the application's support directory, returning publishers for reactive programming integration.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data asynchronously from a specified file in the application support directory, returning a publisher that emits the data or an error.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data asynchronously to a specified file in the application support directory, returning a publisher that emits the file URL or an error.
